name: EPO Open Patent Services (OPS)
tagline: European Patent Office patent bibliographic, legal status, and full-text data API
description: OPS is the European Patent Office's REST web service for worldwide patent bibliographic data, legal status, family information, and full-text documents from EPO and partner offices.

auth.details: OAuth 2.0 client credentials; consumer key/secret exchange for Bearer access token

use_cases: look up patent bibliographic data by number
retrieve legal status for a European patent
